name: @brainarbeit/connect-core
description: The one client-core for the Brainarbeit account-bound connect-once client tier (PWA/desktop/mobile/SDK). Speaks the one-contract; connect-once per-device handshake + mandatory 2FA; single reality (user/<principal>); voice/text/file/path intake; approve/reject/revise; fully bidirectional media (mic/camera/screen + box video/screen + spoken replies).
